_status: UNFUNDED DRAFT. Not posted. Do not post without Oscar.
_shape: description, category, points, deadlineHours, maxCompletions, agentId and location are a FavourSpec (src/lib/board-replenish.ts validateFavourSpec). The other fields are review notes and are not posted.
_reward_note: points are FAVOUR house points, not money. No sponsor or funder exists for any row, so every row is marked unfunded draft. No row promises a payout.
_demand_note: whoWouldWantIt is a plausible requester, written by the drafter. It is not observed demand. No user asked for these.

favours.description: Photo the opening hours posted on the door of the pharmacy nearest you. Say in your note if it is open right now.
favours.proofRequired: One photo where the posted hours can be read. Note: open or closed at the time of the photo, and the town.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Someone checking whether a map listing is right before they walk there. An assistant that answers 'is it open' and has no eyes on the door.

favours.description: Photo the shelf price of a litre of milk and a loaf of bread at your nearest shop. Put your town in the note.
favours.proofRequired: One or two photos with both shelf labels readable. Note: town and country.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Anyone comparing the cost of living between towns. A person about to move. A price tracker that has no shelf data.

favours.description: Find the nearest public water tap or refill point. Photo it and say if water comes out today.
favours.proofRequired: One photo of the tap or fountain. Note: working or not, and the street or park name.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Walkers, runners and travellers who carry a bottle. Refill maps go out of date and nobody checks them.

favours.description: Photo the departure board at your nearest bus or train stop. Say if the next arrival came when the board said.
favours.proofRequired: One photo of the board with times readable. Note: stop name, and early, on time or late by how many minutes.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: A commuter or visitor deciding whether to trust the board. Transit apps repeat the timetable, not what happened.

favours.description: Photo the main entrance of your nearest library, post office or station. Could a wheelchair get in with no help?
favours.proofRequired: One photo showing the whole entrance, steps or ramp included. Note: yes or no, and what is in the way.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Wheelchair users and parents with prams planning a trip. Access data on maps is thin and often wrong.

favours.description: Name one free thing to do in your town this week that no travel guide lists. Say where and when.
favours.proofRequired: A text answer with the place, the day or time, and one line on why it is worth going.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: A visitor with a spare afternoon. A new resident. A local who has run out of ideas.

favours.description: Open the History tab in FAVOUR. Tell us one thing on that screen you did not understand, in one sentence.
favours.proofRequired: A text answer naming the thing on the screen. A screenshot is welcome and not required.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: The FAVOUR team. This is product feedback from the people who use the screen, and it costs them one minute.

favours.description: Translate into the language you speak at home, and name the language: Show your proof, earn your points.
favours.proofRequired: A text answer: the translated line and the name of the language.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: The FAVOUR team, for a first translated screen. Live answers on 4 Oct came in Spanish, Indonesian, Tagalog and Japanese (source: raw/api_tasks.json proof notes).

favours.description: Photo a public notice board near you. Say which notice on it is the most useful to a neighbour, and why.
favours.proofRequired: One photo of the board. Note: the notice you picked and one line of why.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Neighbours who never stop to read it. Anyone new to the area looking for classes, repairs or rooms.

favours.description: Is there a working ATM within five minutes' walk of you? Photo its screen and say if it charges a fee.
favours.proofRequired: One photo of the ATM screen switched on, with no card or personal details in frame. Note: working or not, fee or no fee.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: A traveller who needs notes late at night. Bank locators list machines and do not say which ones work.

favours.description: What is the cheapest filling hot meal within a ten minute walk of you? Name the place, the dish and the price.
favours.proofRequired: A text answer with place, dish and price. A photo of the plate or the menu is welcome.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Students, backpackers and anyone on a tight week. Review sites rank by rating, not by what a full plate costs.

favours.description: What is one trick visitors to your city fall for, and how do locals avoid it? One or two honest lines.
favours.proofRequired: A text answer naming the trick and the way around it.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: A first time visitor to that city. Guidebooks are a year behind the street.

favours.description: Photo the street outside right now. Say if it is flooded, icy, smoky or normal, and name your town.
favours.proofRequired: One photo taken now, outdoors or through a window. Note: the condition and the town.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Someone about to travel there today. A relative checking after bad weather news. Short expiry because conditions change.

favours.description: Run a speed test on your phone where you are. Screenshot the result and name your network and town.
favours.proofRequired: One screenshot showing download and upload speed. Note: network name and town.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: A remote worker choosing where to stay. A traveller picking a SIM. Coverage maps come from the networks themselves.
